summary: # Image-Text Posting (贴图发表, formerly 图文) Post image-text messages with multiple images to WeChat Official Account. > **Note**: WeChat has renamed "图文" to "贴图" in the Official Account menu (as of 2026). ## Usage ```bash # Post with images and markdown file (title/content extracted automatically) npx -y bun ./scripts/wechat-browser.ts --markdown source.md --images ./images/ # Post with explicit title and content npx -y bun ./scripts/wechat-browser.ts --title "标题" --content "内容" --image img1.png --image img2.png # Save as draft
type: skills
tags: skills-sh, skills-sh-all-time
